desc: Ideation: identify that valid colorings correspond to a nonincreasing sequence of row black-prefix lengths.
Implement the row-length interval feasibility check as a Python program.
Verify edge cases and samples: same-row B/W conflicts, black above white allowed, black below/right of white rejected, N=1, unconstrained rows, multiple constraints per row, large N.
Fallback dominance sweep was not needed because the row-length interval check passed all sample tests.
